title: Say Hello
statement:
Greet someone by name.

The input is one line with a name. The name may contain spaces, so read the whole line. Print `Hello, ` followed by the name and then `!`, all on one line. For the name `Grace Hopper` you print `Hello, Grace Hopper!`.

Input:

```text
Ada
```

Expected output:

```text
Hello, Ada!
```
hints: The scaffold already reads the name for you. Your job is the one line of output.
Join three pieces: the text before the name, the name, and the text after it.

python.starter:
def greet(name: str) -> None:
    # TODO: print Hello, <name>!
    pass


name = input()
greet(name)
python.solution:
def greet(name: str) -> None:
    print(f"Hello, {name}!")


name = input()
greet(name)
